title: DGM:归档里的父代采样
note: 移植的是 DGM 的归档规则:父代权重 = sigmoid(10*(分数-0.5)) / (1+子代数),让搜索从"一个走运的祖先"上散开。它的平行子代和 SWE-bench 的日志(含 gold patch)无法带过来,所以这里是一轮一个子代的 DGM,而且少了它最强的那个信号。

deviations.what: The diagnostic prompt carries no gold patch, no private test patch and no test log.
deviations.why: The platform excludes them on purpose (INTERFACE.md 2.3, 2.4): a method that can read the verifier can fit the verifier.

deviations.what: One candidate per round: no parallel children and no rejection.
deviations.why: The `1/(1+children)` term would be inert on a straight chain, so parentage is round-tripped through `method_reported`.
0.1 is an absolute accuracy on SWE-bench, where a round submits hundreds of instances; on a small task set it is many interval widths wide.
